title: GrooveShop Payments Handler Schema
description: Schema for the space.grooveshop.payments UCP payment handler. The handler covers payment methods a business settles outside the agent conversation, where the platform submits no payment credential. Businesses advertise one instrument per active offline payment method they accept.
name: space.grooveshop.payments

payment_instrument.title: GrooveShop Payments Instrument
payment_instrument.description: Any instrument type supported by this handler.

response_schema.title: GrooveShop Payments (Response)
response_schema.description: Runtime handler configuration in checkout and order responses.
